description: This test ensures that users can navigate to the Documentation page from the footer link and access the content.
steps: Scroll to the footer section of the page.
Verify the presence of the Documentation link using its stable selector.
Wait for the redirection to the Documentation page.
Verify that the Documentation page is loaded successfully.
Check for the presence of API reference content on the page.
expected_results: User is redirected to the Documentation page.
API references and guides are accessible.
edge_cases: User's internet connection is interrupted during navigation.
Broken link to the Documentation page.
data_requirements: Browser capable of rendering the Documentation page.
User permissions to access the Documentation content.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Documentation page.
accessibility_requirements: Documentation link is accessible via screen readers.
Keyboard navigation to the Documentation link is supported.
Color contrast of the footer links meets WCAG guidelines.
